guard: on a real terminal, --no-input stops meshes add from opening its guided form, and --no-color draws that form with no color, even under FORCE_COLOR
why: Only a real terminal reaches a prompt, so only the pty suite can show the global flags reach one. bin/cotal.ts loads the CLI and workspace packages from their builds, so each mutation rebuilds what it changes and the restore rebuilds it back.

The theme mutation restores the bug where the setup theme decided color when it loaded, before --no-color was read. The two workspace mutations restore the gap where the prompt library, which asks the terminal stream or FORCE_COLOR, still colored under --no-color.

mutations.name: the guided form ignores --no-input
mutations.expectRed: cotal meshes add --no-input opens no prompt
mutations.cell: cotal meshes add --no-input opens no prompt

mutations.name: color is decided when the theme loads
mutations.replace:
const ansiAtLoad = colorEnabled();
const useAnsi = (): boolean => ansiAtLoad;
mutations.expectRed: meshes add --no-color draws the guided form with no ANSI color
mutations.cell: meshes add --no-color draws the guided form with no ANSI color

mutations.name: the terminal streams still report color under --no-color
mutations.expectRed: meshes add --no-color draws the guided form with no ANSI color
mutations.cell: meshes add --no-color draws the guided form with no ANSI color
mutations.command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/workspace build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli build && pnpm smoke:cli-pty

mutations.name: FORCE_COLOR still forces the prompts under --no-color
mutations.expectRed: meshes add --no-color draws no ANSI color even under FORCE_COLOR
mutations.cell: meshes add --no-color draws no ANSI color even under FORCE_COLOR
mutations.command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/workspace build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli build && pnpm smoke:cli-pty
